blocks.text: TOKYO — It has been a common scene for many pageant girls leaving for their international competitions to pose beside large suitcases by the dozen. But the Miss International pageant is making a statement by imposing a four-piece limit for the participants. Inquirer Entertainment spoke with Miss International Executive Director Stephen Diaz about the new rule on Monday evening, Nov. 23, after the pageant’s Preliminary Evaluation held at the Professional University of Beauty and Wellness in Yokohama, Japan. “It is actually a collective decision because, number one, from the organizers’ point of view, we have observed actually every year how many […]...
